message: Mapped ancient-DNA authentication, population-genetic evidence, direct hybrid evidence, and competing explanations for allele-sharing signals.
Defined ARCHAIC and separated direct-hybrid, allele-sharing, gene-flow, source/time, and functional claims.
Specified sampling, authenticity controls, competing demographic models, haplotype reconstruction, validation, calibration, and design-only safeguards.
Produced and visually verified an 8-page IEEE-style design-only report with 11 numbered equations, 6 tables, 1 workflow figure, and 18 references.
